changelog: Vortex v5.5.32: a simpler Settings menu. The "Launch Display Mode" / windowed-borderless option is gone - it never applied reliably and has been removed along with the code behind it. The three separate live-telemetry switches (Live Aim HUD, Overwolf / Vortex Telemetry, Valorant Tracker fallback) are now one switch, "Enable Live Match Features": turn it on and Vortex enables the aim HUD and pulls in whichever telemetry providers it needs, with the Valorant Tracker log kept as an internal fallback. Everything optional still defaults off except "Stay signed in", and your saved preferences are untouched. The Dashboard button has also been removed from the top header - the live match Dashboard now opens from the large signed-in account card, and nothing about the Dashboard page itself changed.
